details: The implementation diff is confined to governess, read-only utility observability, utility-pane rendering, and their tests.
No tmux geometry, split, resize, move, join, break, or launch-layout commands changed.
Routing, worker scheduling, prompts, budgets, provider behavior, and tool authority remain unchanged.
Utility renders as a third row under the single shared AGENT header with the same column boundaries as Claude and Codex.
Utility maps state, age, model, completed/failed counts, cost, token split, jobs/calls/tools, and latest job id/state; unsupported context and quota values render unavailable.
Rendered AGENT header and data rows are 172 visible columns, within the 176-column limit.
Rendered local-LLM header and rows remain within 176 visible columns.
Only Progress and Next are restored from structured summary state; Project and Objective remain hidden.
Short-viewport tests preserve both frontier-agent rows and utility without overflow, while a seven-row board keeps Progress and Next as the final two lines.
The compact status block retains availability, worker state, jobs, cumulative calls/tools/tokens/cost, routing, delegation, and recent work.
Recent activity is grouped per job and includes requester objective, bounded tool outcome, final response or blocker, duration, calls, tools, tokens, and per-job cost.
Independent 58x20 probe showed request, tool outcome, blocker, 11s duration, 2 model calls, 1 tool call, 1,234 tokens, and $0.0044 cost with maximum line width 48.
The 58x10 regression renders exactly ten lines, each at most 58 characters, while retaining request, tool, result metrics, and result evidence.
Raw tool output is never incorporated into the transcript; provider traces and raw provider messages are not read by the renderer.
Terminal controls and whitespace are normalized, common credential forms remain redacted, and output is width/height bounded.
A valid jobs journal followed by a torn tail still renders prior durable activity, and mixed completed/latest-failed history labels the latest job as failed.
Feature-focused utility observability, utility runtime, and governess suite passed 82/82.
Broad utility, governess, bridge, and tmux suite passed 341/341.
bun run build passed.
git diff --check passed.
The full suite produced 773 passing tests and four failures already established on the canonical baseline.
Those failures are confined to stale Codex model/config expectations in paired-options.test.ts and runner.test.ts and are unrelated to display cleanup.

risks: scripts/verify.sh exits successfully but still contains placeholder lint, typecheck, unit, and integration sections; the explicit Bun suites, build, and diff check are the substantive evidence.
Live replacement of only the utility and governess display panes, plus final Claude/Codex pane-ID and PID preservation, remains a post-integration release check.
Long objectives and results are intentionally normalized and truncated to the live viewport, so durable journals remain the source for full text.
notes: PASS. Initial evaluator findings for torn-tail pane failure and incorrect latest-job status in mixed history were fixed and regression-covered before this verdict.
